book_name: 10 酒店入住 课件词汇

words.tr: n. 登记；注册；挂号；
words.ex: He completed the registration for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了这门课程的登记。
words.en: Registration is the act of officially recording something, especially in an official list or record.

words.tr: n. 需求；要求；必要条件；
words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.tr: n. 押金；存款；
words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.tr:
v. 提升；提高；改进；
n. 增加；改进；
words.ex: He upgraded his phone to get better performance.
words.ex_cn: 他升级了手机以获得更好的性能。
words.en: To upgrade means to improve the quality or usefulness of something, or to raise it to a higher standard. It can also refer to the process of improving or raising something.

words.tr: adj. 无线的；
words.ex: He uses a wireless mouse to work on his laptop.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个无线鼠标在笔记本电脑上工作。
words.en: Using radio, microwaves, etc. (as opposed to wires or cables) to transmit signals.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.tr: n. 便利设施；舒适条件；公共设施；
words.ex: The apartment has good amenities like a gym and a swimming pool.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓有健身房和游泳池等便利设施。
words.en: An amenity is something that makes a place more pleasant or comfortable to live in.

words.tr: n. （车辆等的）停放；停车场所；停车位； v. “park”的现在分词；
words.ex: There is no parking near the school.
words.ex_cn: 学校附近没有停车的地方。
words.en: Parking refers to the act of stopping a vehicle and leaving it temporarily in a particular place.

words.tr: n. 几个；（一）对；夫妻；
words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.tr:
adj. 美国的；美洲的；
n. 美国人；美洲人；
words.ex: She bought an American car.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一辆美国车。
words.en: relating to the United States of America or its people, culture, or language

words.tr:
n. 双胞胎之一；
adj. 成对的；
words.ex: He has a twin brother who looks exactly like him.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个和他长得一模一样的双胞胎兄弟。
words.en: One of two children or animals born at the same birth; to pair or match closely.

words.tr: n. 识别；身份证明；
words.ex: The police used fingerprint identification to find the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用指纹识别来找到嫌疑人。
words.en: Identification is the act of recognizing and naming someone or something, or the process of proving who or what someone or something is.

words.tr: n. 街道；大街；
words.ex: The children play on the street.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在街上玩耍。
words.en: A street is a road in a city, town, or village, usually with houses and buildings on one or both sides.

words.tr: n. 山；山脉；一大堆；大量；
words.ex: He climbed a tall mountain last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他爬了一座高山。
words.en: A mountain is a very high area of land with steep sides, much higher than a hill.

words.tr: n. 接待；招待会；
words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.tr: n. 账单；钞票；议案；
words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.tr: n. 吹风器
words.ex: She uses a hairdryer every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上都用吹风机。
words.en: A hairdryer is an electrical device used to blow warm or hot air over wet hair to speed up the evaporation of water and dry the hair.

words.tr: n. 淋浴；
words.ex: I take a shower every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都洗淋浴。
words.en: A shower is a device that sprays water over you so that you can wash yourself. It is also a short period of rain or snow.

words.tr:
n. 两倍；
v. 加倍；是…的两倍；把…对折；
words.ex: He earned a double of his salary last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月赚了两倍的薪水。
words.en: If something is double, it is twice as much or twice as many. If you double something, you make it twice as much or twice as many.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.tr: n. 接待员
words.ex: The receptionist greeted the visitors with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 接待员微笑着迎接了访客。
words.en: A receptionist is a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, office building, doctor's surgery, etc.

words.tr: n. 签名
words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.
